name: rbush
description: High-performance 2D spatial index for rectangles (based on R*-tree with bulk loading and bulk insertion algorithms)
author: Vladimir Agafonkin

scripts.test: eslint index.js test/test.js && node test/test.js | faucet
scripts.build-min: browserify index.js -s rbush | uglifyjs -c warnings=false -m > rbush.min.js
scripts.prepare: npm run build && npm run build-min
